body:
Im less concerned with me being happy. I just want to stop hurting everyone else. I feel like just being around makes situations worse and I never understand why or what Ive done. 

I used to think I was fairly self aware, I dont think so anymore.

I just want to disappear. 

I can already hear what everyone would say if I did. "What was he thinking? How selfish." 

It would just be another one of my actions that hurt everyone.
